1Paulo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so yɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, sɛdeɛ nkwa a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu bɔhyɛ no teɛ no, 2de kɔma ne dɔba Timoteo: Adom, mmɔborɔhunu, asomdwoeɛ mfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu hɔ nka wo!
Aseda
3 # Aso 23.1; 24.16; Flp 3.5 Meda Onyankopɔn a mefiri ahonim pa mu mesom no sɛ m’agyanom no ase sɛ mekae mo daa wɔ me mpaebɔ mu awia ne anadwo, 4na mekae wo nisuo a, ɛma m’ani gyina sɛ mɛhu woɔ, na anigyeɛ ayɛ me ma, 5#Aso 16.1 na ɛma mekae wo gyidie a nkontompo nni mu a kane na ɛwɔ wo nana Lois ne wo na Eunike mu, na megye medi sɛ ɛwɔ wo nso wo mu no.
Afotuo ahodoɔ
6 # 1 Te 5.19; 1 Ti 4.14 Ɛno nti merekae wo sɛ: Nyane Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdeɛ a ɛnam me nsa a mede meguu wo soɔ no a ɛwɔ wo mu no so ka sɔ ano bio; 7#Rom 8.15 ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn amma yɛn ehu honhom, na mmom ahoɔden ne ɔdɔ ne adwenemuteɛ deɛ.
8 # Rom 1.16 Enti mma w’ani nnwu yɛn Awurade adansedie ne me a meyɛ ne deduani no ho, na mmom hunu asɛmpa no ho amane bi, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn ahoɔden teɛ no. 9#Tito 3.5 Ɔno na wagye yɛn, na ɔde ɔfrɛ kronkron afrɛ yɛn, ɛnyɛ yɛn nnwuma nti, na mmom ne tirim agyina ne adom a wɔde adom yɛn Kristo Yesu mu firi teteete 10#Rom 16.26; 1 Ko 15.54-55; 15.57; Heb 2.14 na afei wɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Kristo Yesu ahoyie so ayi no adie no ho. Ɔno na wayi owuo hɔ, na ɔnam asɛmpa no so ayi nkwa ne adeɛ a ɛmporɔ adi fann. 11#1 Ti 2.7 Ɛno na wɔabɔ din ahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafoɔ ne ɔsomafoɔ ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. 12Ɛno ara nti na mehunu amaneɛ yi nso, nanso m’ani nwu ho; ɛfiri sɛ menim onii ko a magye no madie, na megye medi pa ara sɛ ɔbɛtumi ahwɛ deɛ wɔde ahyɛ me nsa no so asie da no.
13 # 1 Ti 6.3; Tito 2.1 Sɔ nsɛm pa a ɛyɛ a wotee no me nkyɛn no nhwɛsoɔ no mu yie, gyidie ne ɔdɔ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no mu. 14#1 Ti 6.20 Adepa a wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa no, fa Honhom Kronkron a ɔte yɛn mu no so hwɛ so.
Figelo, Hermogene, Onesiforo
15 # 2 Ti 4.16 Wonim yei, sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyinaa adane afiri me nkyɛn, wɔn mu bi ne Figelo, ne Hermogene. 16Awurade nhunu Onesiforo fie mmɔbɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔmaa me ho dwoo me, na n’ani anwu me nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ho. 17Na ɔbaa Roma no, ɔbɔɔ mmɔden hwehwɛɛ me, na ɔhunuu me. 18Awurade mma no nnya Awurade hɔ mmɔborɔhunu ɛda no! Na som a ɔsomm wɔ Efeso no, wo ara wonim yie.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so yɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, sɛdeɛ nkwa a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu bɔhyɛ no teɛ no, de kɔma ne dɔba Timoteo: Adom, mmɔborɔhunu, asomdwoeɛ mfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu hɔ nka wo!

Meda Onyankopɔn a mefiri ahonim pa mu mesom no sɛ m’agyanom no ase sɛ mekae mo daa wɔ me mpaebɔ mu awia ne anadwo, na mekae wo nisuo a, ɛma m’ani gyina sɛ mɛhu woɔ, na anigyeɛ ayɛ me ma, na ɛma mekae wo gyidie a nkontompo nni mu a kane na ɛwɔ wo nana Lois ne wo na Eunike mu, na megye medi sɛ ɛwɔ wo nso wo mu no.

Ɛno nti merekae wo sɛ: Nyane Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdeɛ a ɛnam me nsa a mede meguu wo soɔ no a ɛwɔ wo mu no so ka sɔ ano bio; ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn amma yɛn ehu honhom, na mmom ahoɔden ne ɔdɔ ne adwenemuteɛ deɛ.
Enti mma w’ani nnwu yɛn Awurade adansedie ne me a meyɛ ne deduani no ho, na mmom hunu asɛmpa no ho amane bi, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn ahoɔden teɛ no. Ɔno na wagye yɛn, na ɔde ɔfrɛ kronkron afrɛ yɛn, ɛnyɛ yɛn nnwuma nti, na mmom ne tirim agyina ne adom a wɔde adom yɛn Kristo Yesu mu firi teteete na afei wɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Kristo Yesu ahoyie so ayi no adie no ho. Ɔno na wayi owuo hɔ, na ɔnam asɛmpa no so ayi nkwa ne adeɛ a ɛmporɔ adi fann. Ɛno na wɔabɔ din ahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafoɔ ne ɔsomafoɔ ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Ɛno ara nti na mehunu amaneɛ yi nso, nanso m’ani nwu ho; ɛfiri sɛ menim onii ko a magye no madie, na megye medi pa ara sɛ ɔbɛtumi ahwɛ deɛ wɔde ahyɛ me nsa no so asie da no.
Sɔ nsɛm pa a ɛyɛ a wotee no me nkyɛn no nhwɛsoɔ no mu yie, gyidie ne ɔdɔ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no mu. Adepa a wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa no, fa Honhom Kronkron a ɔte yɛn mu no so hwɛ so.

Wonim yei, sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyinaa adane afiri me nkyɛn, wɔn mu bi ne Figelo, ne Hermogene. Awurade nhunu Onesiforo fie mmɔbɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔmaa me ho dwoo me, na n’ani anwu me nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ho. Na ɔbaa Roma no, ɔbɔɔ mmɔden hwehwɛɛ me, na ɔhunuu me. Awurade mma no nnya Awurade hɔ mmɔborɔhunu ɛda no! Na som a ɔsomm wɔ Efeso no, wo ara wonim yie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
